parts.text: Describe the structure of an **atom** of uranium-238, $^{238}_{92}\text{U}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The decay of uranium-238 is shown by the equation $$^{238}_{92}\text{U} \rightarrow ^{234}_{90}\text{Th} + \text{X}.$$ For nucleus $X$, calculate the ratio, in $\text{C kg}^{-1}$, of $$\frac{\text{charge}}{\text{mass}}.$$

Particle $P$ has no overall charge.

Particle $Q$ has an overall charge of $+2e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.
